scenarios.title: Necromancer summoner normal30 locked at level 30: the allocator hands off to the endgame90 table, loudly, and spends every point
scenarios.provenance: SETUP: level N with the points a played level gives (debug stat, statpts, skillpts). CHEATED setup: mechanics evidence only, never evidence about balance or parity.
scenarios.notes: Horizon handoff (docs/autoalloc.md): normal30 ends at 30, the catalogue lists endgame90 from level 30 and it is supported. Expect the trace line handoff normal30 -> endgame90 at clvl 30, the stored plan, and no unspent skill points. CHEATED setup, mechanics only. Pace: the allocator ticks every 3 s of wall time and spends only when no hostile is near, so a 10 virtual minute run spends a few points, not all 28 (V: first builder run); the assert is the handoff plus at least one spend, not an empty bank.

assert.pattern: auto-alloc: handoff normal30 -> endgame90 at clvl \d+

assert.why: after the handoff the allocator spends from the endgame table
